name: Roast Chicken Thighs with Tomato-Zucchini Couscous

instructions.primary_message: In a large pot, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous and salt, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous
salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
3 pints grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and large dice onions; divide between two baking sheet pans.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the baking sheets with the onion, along with the tomatoes.
Peel and mince garlic; sprinkle over the veggies, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
salt
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp thyme, dried

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides. Add chicken to the baking sheets and nestle into the veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and roast until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, roughly chop olives; pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add both to the pot with the couscous.
Juice lemons into the pot and stir to combine. Cover to keep warm.
Just before serving, transfer roasted veggies to the pot with the couscous and stir to combine.
To serve, divide veggie couscous and chicken thighs between plates. Enjoy!
